picks.editorial_note: A $334 million Schmidt Sciences grant to NCSA for new supercomputing infrastructure is one of the largest single funding commitments to academic AI/HPC capacity this year, with ripple effects across the entire scientific computing community.
picks.title: NCSA Joins the Schmidt Science Computing Network to Expand Advanced Computing for Scientific Discovery

picks.editorial_note: UC Berkeley and Berkeley Lab's entry into the same Schmidt Science Computing Network establishes the new Berkeley Science AI Platform at NERSC, signaling a coordinated multi-institution push to reshape national research computing capacity around AI.
picks.title: UC Berkeley, Berkeley Lab collaboration with Schmidt Science Computing Network will Provide High Performance Computing for Cutting-Edge Research - NERSC: National Energy Research Scientific Computing Center

picks.editorial_note: A £39 million UKRI investment funding 20 Turing AI Fellows at Edinburgh represents a major national-scale bet on AI research talent, with concrete projects spanning turbulence modeling to humanities applications.
picks.title: Turing AI Fellows set to strengthen UK’s AI capability | News | The University of Edinburgh

picks.editorial_note: A systematic review by MIT CSAIL and 17 other institutions cataloguing 95 concrete scenarios of catastrophic AI risk is a significant contribution to the policy conversation around AI safety governance.
picks.title: Researchers find eight ways AI could lead to our downfall

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's FemtoMind project applying agentic AI to lattice QCD calculations marks a genuine scientific application of AI accelerating fundamental particle physics research across multiple national labs.
picks.title: FemtoMind advances Genesis Mission at the proton scale

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's new Center for Marine Intelligence and its AI4Coral partnership with KAUST pairs AI and robotics for automated coral reef monitoring, a notable cross-border academic collaboration with direct environmental application.
picks.title: HKUST Establishes Center for Marine Intelligence and Partners with KAUST to Launch Inaugural AI4Coral Research Project
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: The acquisition of Imperial College London spinout Cogitat by Swiss neurotech firm Indivi, for an EEG-interpreting brain foundation model, shows academic AI research translating directly into commercial neurotechnology.
picks.title: Imperial spinout Cogitat acquired by Swiss startup Indivi for its brain foundation model

picks.editorial_note: A Cambridge-led analysis finding a third of the global AI supply chain invisible to government oversight raises concrete policy concerns about chip production, packaging, and export-control blind spots.
picks.title: A third of the global AI supply chain is ‘invisible’ to governments

picks.editorial_note: DARPA's Triage Challenge Finals demonstrated autonomous systems and human-machine teams performing disaster-scenario victim triage, a tangible benchmark advance for real-world emergency-response AI.
picks.title: DARPA Triage Challenge completes Finals event

picks.editorial_note: A Michigan Tech-UCLA study showing AI models for materials science need far less training data than assumed could meaningfully lower the cost and barrier to AI-driven materials discovery.
picks.title: Less Data, Faster Discovery: Researchers Rethink AI’s Role in Developing New Materials
